source: live run 03.10.2026 20:23, build 4.3.0-c.1, planner on (chat export + event export); player messages and raw planner answers verbatim, listings from the quest.created events
greeting: `Location: Public roadside verge outside Tidecross, Solmere`

listings.title: Striders at the Eel-Weirs
listings.task: Hunt and cull the bog strider colony nesting at the eel-weirs of the Reed Flats so the eel boats can launch safely again.
listings.desired_end_state: The bog strider colony is culled and the eel boats launch from the weirs again.

listings.title: Wolves on the Salt Road
listings.client: Wagonmaster Hessa Vole, Salt Road Freight
listings.task: Escort the salt wagon caravan along the Salt Road to the mill at Brackenford and see it through any trouble on the way.
listings.desired_end_state: The salt wagons arrive intact at Brackenford mill with cargo and drivers unharmed.

listings.title: Medicine for Thornwick
listings.task: Deliver this sealed case of fever tonics to the hedge-healer Old Wenna in Thornwick hamlet before week's end.
listings.desired_end_state: The sealed tonic case is delivered unopened to Old Wenna in Thornwick.

proof.what: Wenna's receipt chalked on the case lid

listings.title: Clear the Feral Dogs of Tannery Row
listings.task: Hunt down and cull the feral dog pack denning under the abandoned tanning sheds on Tannery Row before they take another child.
listings.desired_end_state: The feral dog pack is destroyed and the tanning sheds are safe to work around again.

listings.title: Something in the Oyster Culls
listings.task: Clear whatever monster is stripping the oyster culls at Tull's lease in the shallows of Merrow Point and make the beds safe to work.
listings.desired_end_state: The creature preying on the oyster beds is killed or driven off and the lease crews work the culls again.

objectives.what: the creature raiding the oyster culls
objectives.where: Tull's oyster lease, Merrow Point shallows

proof.what: species-appropriate trophy of the slain creature
